question: Should memory-lancedb autoCapture reject OpenClaw external-content wrappers by default, or should this behavior remain opt-in through a new captureFilter config surface?
rationale: The source-level gap is real, but the permanent fix controls security defaults, config surface area, plugin compatibility, and operator expectations.

options.title: Reject wrappers by default
options.body: Treat EXTERNAL_UNTRUSTED_CONTENT as a host-owned capture boundary before shouldCapture and add memory-lancedb regression coverage.

options.title: Add captureFilter config
options.body: Introduce the requested excludeWrapped option with schema, manifest, docs, and tests while preserving current default behavior.

options.title: Defer to provenance architecture
options.body: Keep this narrow issue open until the broader memory trust/provenance model defines the canonical source-authority contract.

recommendation.title: Reject wrappers by default
recommendation.body: Treat EXTERNAL_UNTRUSTED_CONTENT as a host-owned capture boundary before shouldCapture and add memory-lancedb regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice crosses the external-content security boundary and wrapped-metadata behavior he recently owned or merged.
